# Truth of Market (truthofmarket.com)
> Independent, strictly non-advisory US market data & 2000-2025 historical ETF research publisher (SMH x XLV + SGOV two-pillar study).

## Primary Free Tools & Live Data
- Free 4-Step Historical Sector Backtest Explorer: https://truthofmarket.com/
- Live Daily SMH Semiconductor Fear & Greed Index (7 Public Factors): https://truthofmarket.com/smh-fear-greed
- Live Daily SMH Fear & Greed JSON API: https://truthofmarket.com/data/smh_fg_latest.json
- Free 2-Page 2000-2025 Sample Workbook PDF: https://truthofmarket.com/assets/downloads/tom_sample_2p.pdf
- 12 Crisis Drawdown & Retirement Sequence-Risk Guides Hub: https://truthofmarket.com/guides/

## Public Data Sources & Scope
- Public 1x spot ETF closing price history (SMH, XLV, QQQ, SPY, SGOV, 2000-2025). Zero trade timing signals, zero personal investment advice.
